## Summary

Describe the change and its user-visible effect.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting, lint, typecheck, tests, and builds pass.
- [ ] `pnpm manual:check` passes.
- [ ] If a mode or user-facing feature changed, I updated both
      `docs/USER_MANUAL.md` and `docs/Project_Director_User_Manual.docx`.
- [ ] If the visible mode UI changed, I refreshed the affected screenshots in
      `docs/assets/user-manual/`.
- [ ] If no user-visible behavior changed, I reviewed the manual and recorded
      that conclusion where required by `docs/user-manual-maintenance.md`.
